content.short: Afrixx is a historical generative Cardano NFT project focused on Africa, storytelling, and access rights.
content.description: Afrixx is a historical generative NFT project on Cardano that centers African identity, storytelling, and world-building. The project is community-driven and uses its NFTs to provide utility such as access to events, educational material, media releases, and future ecosystem drops. Afrixx frames Web3 as a way to rediscover and share African history while building a digital community around culture and ownership. Its focus is not only collectible art, but also narrative, education, and early access.
